title: 17 杀心自起18 我竟是个天才
content_zh:
窗外。
林哲羽深呼口气。
他将身子隐藏入黑暗中。
手伸进怀里，掏出黑色的指虎套在手指上。
指虎，也称铁拳头、拳扣、铁四指，是拳法专用的兵器，套在手指上能够提升拳头的杀伤力。
人，他又不是没杀过。
当初混在流民堆里，林哲羽干掉了不止一个想抢他食物的家伙。
现在知道这几个家伙打算对自己不利，林哲羽怎能放过他们。
林哲羽握紧拳头，心情有些复杂。
他只想安安稳稳过日子，过与世无争的悠闲生活。
然而这个世界就是这么残酷，你不主动伤害别人，却会被别人盯上。
屋里的几人聊完暗中的谋划，没有立即离开，拿出酒，喝了起来。
外城的房子，没有内城那般密集。
房子与房子间间隔挺远，有的甚至四周都是田地，中间孤零零地一间屋子。
月亮升起，微风吹拂。
现在已经入冬，天气有些寒冷，以林哲羽现在的体质，倒是没什么感觉。
三人一直喝到深夜，才晃悠悠地从屋里走了出来。
这几個家伙酒量不错，喝了这么久，也只是有了轻微醉意，走路轻微地打起摆子。
这间屋子似乎是三人的临时据点，喝酒打屁后，几人各回各家。
“一个个来，先解决掉比较弱的那两人，再干掉大块头。”

林哲羽暗道。
他悄悄跟上最瘦弱的那人，以最快的速度解决掉他，再跟上其他两人。
“嘶，喝了酒还是这么冷，要添衣服了。”
“等抢了那小子，就有钱换一身暖和的衣服了。”
文彪走在小路上，嘿笑着嘀咕。
他的性格有些畏畏缩缩，既贪图林哲羽的银两，又害怕出现意外。
嗝——
打了个酒隔，文彪感觉舒畅了许多。
月光下，一道黑色的身影快速朝他靠近。
“什么东……”
文彪看到黑影，脑子还没转过来，带着指虎的拳头便落在了他的太阳穴上。
强大的力道震得文彪发晕，指虎上尖锐的凸起刺入太阳穴中。
他张了张嘴想要呼喊求救，嘴却叫不出声来，一只冰凉的粗糙大手捂住了他的嘴巴。
林哲羽左手死死捂住文彪嘴巴，将他牢牢禁锢在自己胸膛，右手快速出拳，朝太阳穴轰去。
连续三拳下去，怀里没了动静，林哲羽这才停下动作，鲜血染红了他的拳头与衣衫。
看着没了声息的尸体，手臂微微颤抖了下，眼神中却闪过一丝坚定。
这个混乱的世道，好人是活不长的。
content_en:
outside the window.
Lin Zheyu took a deep breath.
He hid himself in the darkness.
He reached into his arms and took out a black finger tiger and put it on his fingers.
Zhihu, also known as iron fist, fist buckle, and iron four fingers, is a weapon specially used for boxing. When worn on the fingers, it can increase the lethality of the fist.
It's not like he hasn't killed people before.
When he was among the homeless, Lin Zheyu killed more than one guy who wanted to steal his food.
Now that he knew that these guys were planning to harm him, how could Lin Zheyu let them go.
Lin Zheyu clenched his fists, feeling a little complicated.
He just wants to live a peaceful life and live a leisurely life without fighting against the world.
However, this world is so cruel. If you don't take the initiative to harm others, you will be targeted by others.
After the few people in the room finished chatting about their secret plans, they didn't leave immediately. They took out their wine and started drinking.
The houses in the outer city are not as dense as those in the inner city.
The houses are far apart from each other, and some are even surrounded by fields, with a solitary house in the middle.
The moon rises and the breeze blows.
It's winter now, and the weather is a bit cold. With Lin Zheyu's current physique, he doesn't feel much.
The three of them drank until late at night before wandering out of the house.
These guys had a good capacity for drinking. After drinking for so long, they were only slightly drunk, and they walked with a slight sway.
This room seemed to be a temporary base for the three of them. After drinking and spanking, they went back to their respective homes.
"Come on one by one, take out the weaker two first, and then the big guy."
Lin Zheyu said secretly.
He quietly followed the thinnest man, got rid of him as quickly as possible, and then followed the other two.
"Hey, I'm still so cold after drinking wine. I need to put on more clothes."
"When you rob that boy, you'll have money to put on warm clothes."
Wen Biao walked on the path, laughing and muttering.
His character is a bit timid, coveting Lin Zheyu's money and afraid of accidents.
Burp——
After taking a drink, Wen Biao felt much more comfortable.
Under the moonlight, a black figure quickly approached him.
"What the hell..."
When Wen Biao saw the black shadow, before his mind could turn around, a fist with a fingertip fell on his temple.
The powerful force shocked Wen Biao, and the sharp protrusions on his fingertips pierced into his temples.
He opened his mouth to shout for help, but no sound came out. A cold, rough hand covered his mouth.
Lin Zheyu covered Wen Biao's mouth with his left hand, tightly restraining him in his chest, and punched quickly with his right hand towards the temple.
After punching three times in a row, there was no movement in his arms. Lin Zheyu stopped moving, and his fists and clothes were dyed red with blood.
Looking at the soundless corpse, his arms trembled slightly, but a trace of determination flashed in his eyes.
In this chaotic world, good people will not live long.
